note: WhyChain's intent registry for Meterless Scout Intent: which part of WhyChain answers a question. The examples are written for the registry; none is one of WhyChain's eval questions (evals/cases.yaml), so routing them is a real test.

intents.description: Not a question about orders, deliveries, stock, suppliers, carriers, customers or the company's data. Answered at once; nothing is investigated.
examples: What's the capital of France?
Tell me a joke
hello there
Write me a poem about the sea

intents.description: Explain why deliveries were late, slower, or missed their promised date, or why the on-time rate fell: for a period, a place, a carrier, a seller or around an event.
examples: Why were orders to Bahia delivered late in April 2018?
What caused the drop in on-time delivery last month?
Did the postal strike slow down our deliveries?
Why is carrier transit so slow to the north of the country?
Why did delays spike after the holidays?
Why have shipments to Bengaluru been arriving late since August?
Are parcels to Recife late more often than elsewhere, and why?

intents.description: Explain a stock-out or shortage, backordered orders, a jump in the open-order backlog, or orders at risk of missing their promised date because stock is short.
examples: Why did the Thane warehouse run out of chargers?
Why are so many orders at the Kolhapur DC backordered?
Why is the open-order backlog growing this week?
Which orders will miss their promised date next week because of stock, and why?
Why are we short of cables at the Surat DC?
What is behind the keyboard shortage?

intents.description: Any other question about the company's data that needs an open-ended investigation: reviews, revenue, prices, payments, sellers, returns, cancellations, customers.
examples: Why did review scores fall in May?
Which sellers have the most cancellations, and why?
Why did the average order value drop this quarter?
Why are payments by boleto failing more often?
Why did revenue from electronics fall?
What do customers complain about most in their reviews?
